reducedMotion.title: Reduced motion
reducedMotion.note: Spatial movement is removed. Written state remains. This strip is page-level, not a cell inside every part.

cells.title: Loading without motion
cells.note: Loading remains readable when motion is reduced.

cells.title: Expanded without travel
cells.note: Menu visibility remains when motion is reduced.

interaction.title: Motion and interaction
interaction.note: These cells are live. Frozen catalog cells stay pointer-events none. Every approved reference family has one live exemplar here. Icons and charts stay MISSING until they have real primitives.

cells.title: Button hover
cells.html: <button class="sumi-button" type="button" data-graph-live>Approve</button>
cells.note: Hover and press use the 160ms control duration. The action label stays put.

cells.title: Button loading
cells.html: <button class="sumi-button" type="button" data-graph-loading>Approve</button>
cells.note: Click writes LOADING on the same label. It does not invent success.

cells.title: Dropdown open
cells.note: Open, hover, select, and dismiss in place. The menu does not travel.

cells.title: Segmented select
cells.note: Selected segment uses ink fill. Color is not the only state.

cells.title: Toggle press
cells.note: Pressed state is immediate and written into aria-pressed.

cells.title: Tab switch
cells.note: Active tab uses the ink underline plus selected state.

cells.title: Field focus
cells.note: Focus writes the seal marker. Tab or click the field.

cells.title: Date edit
cells.note: Edit the date. Invalid values write a correction under the field.

cells.title: Command index
cells.note: Current destination uses ink inversion plus written state.

cells.title: App shell destination
cells.note: Switching destination rewrites CURRENT on the selected row.

cells.title: Toast retry

Error

Ledger source unavailable

cells.note: Retry writes Loading, then returns to the error. Empty stays distinct from unavailable.
